• Status: accepted
  • Date: 2026-07-31

Context

Mobile release evidence needs aggregate operational signals, but a native app cannot safely hold an OTLP backend credential and must not emit account, device/session, paper, content, token, raw exception, or stack data. Allowing arbitrary OTLP attributes would make privacy behavior depend on every callsite and could bypass backend redaction expectations.

Decision

Mobile sends best-effort, unauthenticated HTTPS POSTs only to the exact environment /v1/logs endpoint. A dedicated Rust gateway accepts one bounded JSON/OTLP payload shape, rejects unknown event names/attributes and sensitive keys, enforces 16 KiB/request and media-type/method/path limits, and exports accepted records to the in-cluster Collector. The app has a two-second deadline, at most two in-flight sends, and no persistent queue, retry, cookie, authorization header, or identifier. Failure drops telemetry without changing product behavior.

Ingress supplies coarse per-client connection/rate limits. The gateway's closed schema is the privacy boundary. As a second layer, the downstream Collector preserves a log body only when its service, environment, scope, and event name exactly match this schema; every other direct-OTLP log body is replaced by a static marker. Crash-free release evidence uses an externally reviewed aggregate distribution/store denominator rather than inventing a stable identifier.

Before an application failure crosses a framework, platform, zone, or bootstrap diagnostic boundary, the client replaces the original exception and Dart stack with one bounded error category and StackTrace.empty. If no prior handler accepts it, that replacement remains uncaught so crash behavior is not hidden; the raw callback arguments are never returned to the engine fallback logger.

Plan 02 queue-policy observations use the same closed boundary. The client may emit only coarse duration buckets for pending save/import age, save-to- suppression latency, final-acknowledgement-to-server-unlock latency, and oldest Library outbox age. Recommendation publication rejection and Library conflict events use closed reason/boundary enums. The source timestamps, account/auth scope, outbox operation, import operation, paper identity, and server response identity remain on-device. A missing timestamp or scope produces unknown or no timing sample; it is never reconstructed from a raw timestamp attribute. These are essential queue and product-state observations and do not enable interaction or personalization collection when personalization is off.

Consequences

  • The mobile bundle contains no observability credential and direct upstream OTLP coordinates remain private.
  • New event/attribute vocabulary requires code, tests, privacy disclosure, and gateway review before rollout.
  • Offline and saturated periods intentionally lose telemetry, so metrics are operational samples rather than complete behavioral analytics.
  • Source tests can prove validation/redaction mechanics, but live retention, ingress behavior, representative crash windows, and store disclosures remain external release evidence.
htmlZh:
• 状态：已接受
  • 日期：2026-07-31

背景

移动版发布证据需要聚合的运营信号，但原生应用无法安全持有 OTLP 后端凭据， 也不得发送账户、设备/会话、论文、内容、令牌、原始异常或堆栈数据。 如果允许任意 OTLP 属性，隐私行为就会取决于每一个调用位置， 并可能绕过后端既定的脱敏要求。

决策

移动端只向当前环境中精确的 /v1/logs 端点发送尽力而为、未经认证的 HTTPS POST 请求。专用 Rust 网关只接受一种有界的 JSON/OTLP 载荷结构， 拒绝未知事件名称、未知属性和敏感键，执行每个请求 16 KiB 的上限以及媒体类型、 方法和路径限制，并将接受的记录导出到集群内的 Collector。应用设置两秒截止时间， 最多允许两个进行中的发送，并且不使用持久队列、重试、Cookie、Authorization 请求头或标识符。 发送失败时直接丢弃遥测，不改变任何产品行为。

Ingress 提供按客户端计算的粗粒度连接数和限流。网关的封闭 schema 构成隐私边界。 作为第二层防护，下游 Collector 仅在服务、环境、作用域和事件名称与该模式完全一致时 保留日志正文；其余所有直接 OTLP 日志正文都会替换为固定标记。 无崩溃发布证据采用经过外部审核的聚合分发/商店分母，绝不为此虚构稳定标识符。

在应用故障跨越框架、平台、Zone 或启动诊断边界之前，客户端会把原始异常和 Dart 堆栈替换为一个有界错误类别及 StackTrace.empty。如果此前没有处理程序接收 该故障，替换后的故障仍保持未捕获状态，从而不会掩盖崩溃行为；原始回调参数绝不会 交回引擎的后备日志记录器。

Plan 02 的队列政策观测也使用同一个封闭边界。客户端只能上报以下项目的粗粒度时长桶： 待处理保存/导入的存在时长、从保存到推荐抑制的延迟、从最终确认到服务端解除锁定的延迟， 以及 Library 中最早待同步队列（outbox）项目的存在时长。推荐发布被拒与 Library 冲突事件使用封闭的 原因/边界枚举。源时间戳、账户/认证作用域、待同步队列（outbox）操作、导入操作、论文身份和服务器响应 身份都只保留在设备上。时间戳或作用域缺失时，只产生 unknown 或不生成计时样本； 绝不会根据原始时间戳属性重建。这些是必要的队列和产品状态观测；关闭个性化功能时， 它们不会借机启用交互或个性化数据收集。

后果

  • 移动应用包不含可观测性凭据，直接上游 OTLP 坐标保持私密。
  • 新增事件或属性词汇必须先完成代码、测试、隐私披露和网关审核，才能逐步发布。
  • 离线或容量饱和期间会有意丢失遥测，因此这些指标只是运营抽样，并非完整的行为分析。
  • 源码测试可以证明校验和脱敏机制，但真实保留行为、入口行为、具有代表性的崩溃窗口和应用商店披露信息仍须作为外部发布证据。
